source_text: De eo quod scriptum est: tu et filii tui et domus patris tui tecum sumetis peccata sanctuarii. Qui meliores sunt, inferiorum semper culpas suscipiunt. Apostolus: vos qui firmiores estis imbecillitates infirmorum sustinete. Israelita laicus peccans requirit levitatem sacerdotem pontificem; sacerdos si delinquat, suum potest purgare nisi peccet in Deum.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning that which written-is: you and sons your and house of-father your with-you will-take sins of-sanctuary. Who better are, of-inferiors always faults take-up. Apostle: you who stronger are weaknesses of-weak sustain. Israelite layperson sinning requires Levite priest high-priest; priest if he-fail, his-own is-able to-cleanse unless he-sin against God.
pass_b_english: On the word [[You and your sons and your father’s house with you shall bear the sins of the sanctuary >> Bible:Numbers 18:1]]: the better always take up the faults of those below. The Apostle says, [[You who are stronger, bear the weaknesses of the weak >> Bible:Romans 15:1]]. A lay Israelite who sins needs Levite, priest, even high priest; a priest who fails can cleanse his own — unless he sins against God.
